buildCommand: mkdir -p site/data site/shared && cp index.html app.js style.css site/ && cp shared/normalize.js site/shared/ && cp data/tech_registry.json data/enriched.json data/district_coords.json site/data/ && ([ -f data/registry_meta.json ] && cp data/registry_meta.json site/data/ || true)

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://unpkg.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://unpkg.com; img-src 'self' data: https://*.tile.openstreetmap.org https://unpkg.com; connect-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'
